name: 读取每日任务面板的活跃度与任务行
preconditions: entry element BTN_OPEN_DAILY present in the current frame (template lookup, never a remembered coordinate)
action-specific verifier exists before real try  -- verify_open_daily / verify_daily_tab_selected

verification.open_daily: verify_open_daily(before=HOME frame, after=panel frame) -> opened 2026-10-05: OK, evidence {before_home: true, after_task_board: true}
verification.daily_tab_selected: verify_daily_tab_selected -> NOT APPLICABLE on a HOME->DAILY pair (its before-half requires a task-board page drawn on another tab). Its after-half was true: after_tab == "TASKS". It is only meaningful when a tab SWITCH was actually performed.

success_condition_status.activity_known: YES -- measured live 2026-10-05: activity=70, read off the frame, cross-checked against the drawn badge
success_condition_status.tiers_known: NO -- the 7 chest thresholds are drawn on the panel and were located with pixel positions, but the production reading (WorldState.daily) does NOT emit them. The reading has no reward-tier field at all.
success_condition_status.honest_verdict: PARTIAL. This is a Step, not a complete Skill: the counter is read, the tier strip is measured but not wired.

spend: none -- reading the panel costs nothing and this record performs no claim. Claiming (DAILY_CLAIM_REWARDS / 一键领取) is a separate capability with its own verifier.
blocker: DAILY_REWARD_TIER is not emitted by the reading: the 7 chest numbers are measured on the frame (positions below) but no field carries them, so activity_and_tiers_known is only half satisfied
verified_variant: 3 visible task rows, 1 of them COMPLETED, status=CLAIMABLE, activity=70, opened directly on the 每日任务 tab

branches.opened_directly_on_daily_tab: measured 2026-10-05 -- the entry landed with 每日任务 as both the top heading AND the selected bottom tab, so NO tab switch was needed. The stored note that OPEN_DAILY lands on the panel's first tab (章节任务) therefore describes another client state, not a constant.
branches.opened_on_another_tab: not observed this run. If it happens: tap BTN_DAILY_TAB_TASKS once, then verify with verify_daily_tab_selected and re-observe -- never repeat a navigation tap from a stale frame.
branches.task_completed: a completed row draws 领取 BELOW the title (measured (597,579) for the title at y=507), not 前往 at the same row's right edge
branches.task_incomplete: an incomplete row draws 前往 at x=597, at title_y+72 (measured y=746 and y=911 for titles at y=674 and y=840)
branches.nothing_claimable: not observed; status would read AVAILABLE with the 一键领取 control absent

operator_policy.spend: zero -- the operator's zero-spend principle reserves diamonds for 统帅经验; nothing on this panel costs anything
operator_policy.claiming: free rewards only, and claiming is a different capability; this record only reads
operator_policy.inverted_confidence_rule: the drawn tab state and the drawn activity badge outrank any template layer's constant -- see failure_patterns[0]

failure_patterns.what: vision.py:2338-2345 returns literal dicts with hardcoded numbers at confidence 0.99 -- {activity: 70} from DAILY_ACTIVITY_70_CURRENT, and {task_id: HERO_RECRUIT_1, progress: 0, target: 1, activity: 270} from BTN_DAILY_GO_HERO_RECRUIT. Those are the values of whichever single frame each template was cut from, published as if measured.
failure_patterns.measured: on dataset/raw/live_daily_after_beast.png the template layer said activity=70 while the frame really shows 270 (labelled in tests/replay/labels.json: claimed_milestones [40,80,120,160,215,270], next_milestone 325, element DAILY_ACTIVITY_270). The OCR layer read 270 and the merge (ocr.py:6032) let 270 win.
failure_patterns.why_it_has_not_bitten_yet: HybridVision merges OCR over the template on a per-key basis, and the OCR branch reads the real number -- so on a normal daily frame the constant is overwritten. It is only exposed when the two layers disagree about the PAGE, because then the merge is skipped entirely (ocr.py:6032 requires secondary.page is primary.page).
failure_patterns.honest_status: recorded, NOT fixed. Touching the legacy recogniser's branches has a wide blast radius and the mask above means this needs its own measurement round first.
failure_patterns.guard: tests/test_daily_panel_reading.py pins that the production reading's activity comes from the OCR layer, not from the template constant, on a real frame where the two disagree.

failure_patterns.what: the page classifier names the page from the literal 每日任务, which the client draws on the tab BAR even while another tab is selected -- documented at vision.py:2316-2321, where the cost is recorded: on 2026-09-16 the account stood at activity 285 with its three chests (80/160/215/270) already passed and the run could not see any of it.
failure_patterns.consequence: any reader must confirm the TAB, not just the page, before trusting a row list

failure_patterns.what: the project's note says OPEN_DAILY lands on the panel's first tab (章节任务), which is why a tab-switch step exists at all. Measured 2026-10-05: the entry landed with 每日任务 as both the top heading and the selected bottom tab, so the switch was unnecessary.
failure_patterns.consequence: the tab switch must stay CONDITIONAL (read the drawn tab first), never unconditional -- an unconditional switch on a panel already showing 每日任务 is a tap with no legal target

failure_patterns.what: recorded in semantic_dictionary.json:1740 for BTN_DAILY_TASK_GO: the first frame after tapping 前往 remained DAILY, and the page changed only later.
failure_patterns.consequence: never assume a synchronous page change; re-observe. This record does not tap 前往 at all, so it is a warning for the next capability (following a daily task), not for this one.

failure_patterns.what: community sources give per-task activity points and a '100 activity is the daily target' rule (gozwgame), while this client draws a 7-tier strip whose maximum is 325 and whose thresholds are 40/80/120/160/215/270/325 (measured on a real frame and corroborated independently by AppGamer's 'up to 325 points').
failure_patterns.consequence: external tables are recorded as hypotheses only, per the standing order 真机观察 > Episode > CONFIRMED > OBSERVED > 官方 > 社区 > 视频 > 模型推测. Nothing from them was written into this record as fact.
